title: 7.10 Seasons
unit_outcome: Talk about the body, feelings, clothes, the weather and seasons, free time and invitations, ask people to repeat or speak slowly, and name things outdoors, animals, sports and music in Spanish.
goal: Name the seasons and the weather you see: Es primavera. Veo la nieve.
grammar_function: Es + season; Veo el sol / la lluvia / la nieve; Está templado.
speaking_outcome: Name the seasons and the weather you see: Es primavera. Veo la nieve.
